$comment: Copyright 2026 uds-takserver authors. SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only. Policy of image/licence_gate.py for the TAKX desktop prototype image. Seeded from the verified compliance synthesis of 2026-11-25 (issue #934). Not a legal review: the identifiers record what each source declares; "review" marks what a qualified person still has to confirm.

allow.BSD-3-Clause: permissive; also the Eclipse Distribution License 1.0
allow.Ubuntu-font-1.0: font licence of the JogAmp graph fonts
allow.GPL-3.0-only: licence of this project, of TAKX and of atak-civ
allow.CC-BY-4.0: OpenMapTiles style design; needs the visible credit that "acknowledgements" checks
allow.LicenseRef-Public-Domain: declared public domain by its POM

review.EPL-2.0: no secondary licence found; combination with GPL-3.0-only code needs a combined-work versus aggregate opinion (compliance C.4, C.5)
API JARs offered under EPL-2.0 or this; review against GPL-3.0-only (compliance C.5)
review.GPL-2.0-or-later WITH Classpath-exceptio: alternative offered by the bytedeco wrappers next to Apache-2.0; not the alternative that counts
review.Apache-1.1: advertising and naming clauses; combination with GPL-3.0 needs an opinion (compliance C.4)
review.BSD-4-Clause: advertising clause; combination with GPL-3.0 needs an opinion (compliance C.4)
review.LicenseRef-IndianaExtreme-1.1.1: XPP3 inside jboss-modules: acknowledgement clause in the Apache-1.1 style (compliance C.4)
review.BSD-3-Clause-No-Nuclear-Warranty: nuclear-facility acknowledgement wording; likely fine, confirm (inventory item 8)

deny.LicenseRef-FFmpeg-nonfree: the binary states that it is nonfree and unredistributable
deny.CDDL-1.0: CDDL-only code in a GPL-3.0 distribution (compliance C.3)
deny.CDDL-1.1: CDDL-only code in a GPL-3.0 distribution (compliance C.3)
deny.MPL-1.1: MPL-1.1-only code in a GPL-3.0 distribution (compliance C.4, E.2)
deny.LicenseRef-unlicensed-font: a font or font atlas named after a proprietary font, with no licence (compliance C.2)
